newsitem.title: USA: AEGON, Providian amend deal price.
newsitem.headline: AEGON, Providian amend deal price.

text.p: Providian Corp said Thursday that it and Aegon NV have agreed upon a pricing structure beyond the collar outlined in the merger agreement between the companies announced five months ago.

Providian said that the new pricing structure assures that its shareholders, subject to the calculation of the exchange ratio set forth in the merger agreement, will participate in 50 percent of the appreciation of the Aegon share price above US$66.713.
Aegon's closing stock price in New York US$73.125 on Wednesday.
The amendment to the merger agreement implies that the value of the share exchange will increase by more than US$21 million with each US$1 increase in the average Aegon share price above US$66.713.

On December 30, 1996, both companies announced that Aegon would acquire the insurance operations of Providian and merge them with the insurance operations of its Aegon USA subsidiary in a transaction valued at US$3.5 billion.
